Great food!
Feb 2020 • Couples
We visited this restaurant based on Trip Advisor reviews and weren't disappointed! The quaint little restaurant is set just off one of the main streets and while the decor is fairly plain and simple, the food is brilliant. We had the pork Banh Mi, two bowls of Pho, fried spring rolls, a juice, soft drink and beer, all for just over US$10. Really delicious food too. I'd happily return if in the area again. The staff were also very prompt and friendly. They serve the beers in frozen glasses too which is fantastic on a hot day.

Good Food with clean flavours
Jan 2020
I have been eating here every second day for almost a month and the food is really good. The prices are fair and the dishes are fresh and well proportioned. The juices are freshly made and the pineapple juice was delicious. I have tried a number of their noodle dishes and all were very good. The service is excellent and very friendly. This was one of my favourite restaurants near the beach in Danang. I highly recommend it to travellers and locals alike.
